facts.sessionPlanned: Persisted session is planned and belongs to the selected request
facts.slotAvailable: Selected slot is still free for the assigned trainer and linked participants
facts.eventVerified: Calendar event ID, time, and attendees were read back and match the session
facts.receiptSaved: The session row records the verified event
facts.eventAndGuestVerified: Persisted event and one assigned guest response were read back
facts.assignedTrainer: Verified responder matches the trainer assigned to the session
facts.trainerFormVerified: Trainer form has VERIFIED email collection and matches the session
facts.trainerPass: Accepted trainer assessment reports attended and passed for this person and phase
facts.assignedParticipant: Verified responder matches the participant linked to the case
facts.participantFormVerified: Participant form has VERIFIED email collection and matches the case
facts.allPhaseEvidence: Every required phase has accepted trainer and participant responses
facts.proofVerified: Proof IDs, version, source hash, and source responses match this case
facts.drivePdfVerified: Drive PDF is readable and its case/version metadata matches the proof
facts.localPdfVerified: Local PDF is readable and its SHA-256 matches the Drive PDF
facts.archiveReceiptVerified: Archive receipt matches case, proof, version, and source hash
facts.liveLevelUnchanged: The live matrix level equals the case's original level

result.trainerPass: true only when attended and passed
